dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Numerous high-intensity 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are distributed across the posterior and mid-lateral regions. These structures feature a sharp gradient transition from a low-intensity (dark) background to a high-intensity (light) perimeter, enclosing a lower-intensity central void.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A significant concentration of high-intensity pixels forms a large, diffuse, asymmetrical blob in the upper-central dorsal region. Smaller, localized clusters of solid high-intensity pixels are scattered throughout the anterior section, lacking internal gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of four prominent macro-annuli on the posterior-right flank form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral. The geometric relationship between the central dorsal high-intensity blob and the two closest macro-annuli below it forms an approximate isosceles triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture exhibits a dense, interlocking reticulated or 'honeycomb' pattern in the mid-lateral field where the boundaries of individual annuli merge into a continuous high-contrast lattice.
